run_resolver_component_tests: run the gRPC c-ares DNS resolver component tests against a local DNS server with all 29 test cases
run_test_with_custom_args: run resolver tests by passing extra comma-separated args via the --extra_args CLI flag
wait_until_dns_server_is_up: wait up to 30 attempts for the local DNS server to respond over TCP and UDP before running tests
test_runner_log: log a message to stderr prefixed with the script file name for test runner diagnostics
python_args: prepend the Python executable to an argument list on Windows for cross-platform subprocess invocation
